source.title: Open Problems Related to a Herglotz-Type Formula for Vector-Valued Mappings

needs_review.question_text_raw: In a manner similar to how the one-variable Herglotz formula facilitates a representation of convex mappings of the disk, we apply the new transformation to convex mappings of B and present some additional open questions.
